items.synthesis: Small disks were cut from ingots, and two disks of different composition were pressed with a fastener, sealed in an evacuated quartz capsule and then heat treated at 1000 °C for 2 h to obtain a diffusion couple.

items.quote: Small disks were cut from ingots, and two disks of different composition were pressed with a fastener, sealed in an evacuated quartz capsule and then heat treated at 1000 °C for 2 h to obtain a diffusion couple.

The prepared diffusion couples were then resealed in the evacuated quartz capsule and equilibrated in the temperature region of 750-900 °C for 600-2500 h. After the heat treatment, the diffusion couple was quenched in ice water and microstructural examination of the diffusion couple was carried out by an optical microscope.
